Before power factor 0.8, after 0.9, total active calculated load 750 kW. Find capacitor reactive compensation capacity approximate. Formula Qc = P (tan φ1 - tan φ2). cos1=0.8 => tan1=0.75. cos2=0.9 => tan2=sqrt(1-0.81)/0.9 = sqrt0.19 /0.9 ≈0.43589/0.9=0.4843. Difference=0.2657. *750=199.3 kvar. Answer C 200. Need final line 答案：C. content:
计算补偿容量：

\[
Q_c = P(\tan\varphi_1-\tan\varphi_2)
\]

补偿前：

\[
\cos\varphi_1=0.8,\quad \tan\varphi_1=0.75
\]

补偿后：

\[
\cos\varphi_2=0.9,\quad \tan\varphi_2\approx0.484
\]

所以：

\[
Q_c=750\times(0.75-0.484)\approx199.5\text{ kvar}
\]

最接近 200 kvar。

答案：C
